Participants (45 female and 45 male native speakers of German
between 18 and 45 years of age) ... The contrast

between masculine generics on one hand and the two alternative

generics on the other was statistically significant (p < .01).
reason: Primary source identity is confirmed (Stahlberg, Sczesny, & Braun, 2001, Journal of Language and Social Psychology, 20(4), 464-469). In Experiment 2, 45 female and 45 male participants (total N = 90) were randomly assigned across the three generic language conditions for the pooled contrast between masculine generics and the two alternative generics (with 4 participants excluded only in a separate Note 3 sensitivity repetition).
